description: How to interpret absence of evidence by jurisdiction (Enhancement 10)

silence_interpretations.description: Different jurisdictions have different announcement cultures

US.rationale: US banks rarely announce technology initiatives publicly; silence doesn't indicate non-adoption
US.notes: US banks are secretive about competitive technology initiatives

UK.rationale: UK banks announce major initiatives; silence may suggest no major CDM investment
UK.notes: UK trade press coverage is good; absence likely means no major initiative

Switzerland.rationale: Swiss banks actively announce technology initiatives; silence suggests non-adoption
Switzerland.notes: UBS and Credit Suisse both have active technology communications

EU.rationale: European banks announce regulatory compliance initiatives
EU.notes: EMIR Refit drove many announcements; post-deadline silence may indicate traditional approach

Germany.rationale: German banks announce major technology initiatives
Germany.notes: Deutsche Bank particularly active in public communications

France.rationale: French banks announce major initiatives; BNP is known CDM leader
France.notes: BNP Paribas sets benchmark; other French banks expected to announce if adopting

Japan.rationale: Japanese banks announce via JSCC/FSA channels; direct bank announcements rare
Japan.notes: JSCC CDM mandate forces announcement by deadline; pre-deadline silence doesn't indicate non-adoption

Singapore.rationale: Singapore banks follow MAS guidance closely; announcements expected for major initiatives
Singapore.notes: DBS and OCBC are technology leaders; expected to announce CDM if adopting

Hong_Kong.rationale: HKMA-regulated banks follow similar patterns to Singapore
Hong_Kong.notes: Hong Kong follows Singapore regulatory patterns

Australia.rationale: Australian banks announce major technology initiatives
Australia.notes: Big Four Australian banks are active in technology communications

time_sensitive_rules.description: How silence interpretation changes around regulatory deadlines

rules.rationale: Silence post-deadline suggests traditional approach taken

when_to_apply: During synthesis stage when weighing evidence
When calculating confidence for UNKNOWN classification
When comparing banks within same jurisdiction
how_to_apply: Multiply base LR by lr_for_silence when no evidence found
Consider time_sensitive rules for regulatory deadlines
Weight silence more heavily for 'active' announcement cultures
cautions: Always combine with other evidence types
Consider non-English sources before concluding silence

usage_notes: Applied during synthesis to adjust confidence when evidence is absent
lr_for_silence < 1.0 means silence is evidence against adoption
